tasks.short: Assist with protective equipment selection and fit

steps.what: Assist coaches and therapists in selecting appropriate protective equipment
Assist in fitting equipment and check comfort, movement and protection concerns

tasks.design: Retain clinical advice on equipment choice and direct observation of fit. Manufacturer instructions in {DOCS} support the encounter; no measurement alone or generated recommendation is treated as proof of protective performance.
tasks.previous_blocker: Selection and fit depend on the athlete, activity and actual equipment.
tasks.enabler_now: Information retrieval does not remove hands-on fitting assistance.
tasks.still_hard: Comfort, movement restrictions and protection can conflict, and equipment-specific expertise may be needed.
tasks.human_edge: The physician notices individual clinical concerns and seeks specialist fitting support when appropriate.
tasks.altitude: Equipment-advice responsibility and time remain unchanged.

reach.task: Describe clinical constraints for specialist equipment assessment

evidence.claim: Keeping equipment-selection and physical-fit assistance human is an E1 assessment from model knowledge; no applicable validated fitting capability appears in the digest.

assumptions: Boundary is the physician's assistance, excluding purchasing, certification and the coach's or therapist's separate fitting work.
The coach or therapist brings selected equipment to the athlete between s1 and s2 through existing fitting work. No new transfer is introduced and outside labour earns no focal saving.
No structured body-measurement input, automatic size selection or verified-safe-fit flag is presumed. Existing equipment instructions suffice; no custom system is proposed.
Zero incremental upkeep because no process changes. Equipment-specific fitting authority is a customer fact.
unknowns: Equipment types and specialist fitting arrangements
research_questions: Which observed fit concerns require equipment-specific specialist assessment rather than routine adjustment?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 gross0 net0. Selection advice and physical fitting observation retain all time; no catalogue or measurement-entry baseline is invented.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Continue direct clinical support for protective equipment choice and fit; no time or decision-right change is claimed.
reach: Give orthotists clear clinical context for specialist assessment
role.ambitious_version: A sports medicine physician who helps coaches and therapists recognise equipment concerns and obtain appropriate specialist fitting support.
